fields.description: Output schema for scraped Facebook public reshares.

sharerId.description: Facebook user ID of the person who shared the post.

sharerName.description: Display name of the person who shared the post.

sharerProfileUrl.description: Profile URL of the person who shared the post.

sharePostId.description: Post ID of the outer reshare story.

shareStoryId.description: GraphQL Story ID of the outer reshare.

shareUrl.description: Canonical permalink of the outer reshare post.

sharedAtUnix.description: Canonical share timestamp in Unix seconds (extracted from edge.node.creation_time).

sharedAtIso.description: Share timestamp in ISO-8601 UTC format.

sharedAtLocal.description: Share timestamp formatted in the requested local timezone.

visibility.description: Declared privacy scope of the reshare (e.g. Public).

scrapedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the record was collected by the crawler.
